LightningComponentBundle.description: Shows external Boundary Applications connected to the current record's object, as criticality-colored chips that expand to show sync pattern, ownership, and last-validated date. Works on record pages, app pages, Flow screens, and the utility bar.

property.name: fieldApiName
property.label: Field API Name (optional)
property.description: Narrow the impact check to a single field on this record's object, e.g. Email. Leave blank to show every application connected to the object.

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: The API name of the Salesforce object to check, e.g. Account or a custom object such as Invoice__c.
